title: Zero Cellular
summary: 4G LTE Phone, SMS & Data client for Cardputer Zero with DJI(QDC507) 4G module
description:
Zero Cellular is a standalone native CardputerZero application for DJI(QDC507) 4G LTE cellular modules. Built directly on the Linux framebuffer (/dev/fb_lcd) and evdev with FreeType-hinted system fonts (DejaVu Sans + Noto Sans CJK SC Medium), it runs completely unprivileged with low memory footprint.
Features:
  - VoLTE Voice Calls: Dialer, recent call log, incoming ringtone & alert, live call timer, DTMF keypad, instant mic mute, and live speaker volume / mic gain controls via software Blackman-sinc RateBridge and PipeWire audio routing.
  - SMS Messaging: Conversation list with unread indicators, multi-part GSM-7 & UCS-2 (CJK) send/receive, wrapped chat bubbles, and inline reply composer.
  - Mobile Data & Telemetry: Live operator, LTE band, RSRP signal bars, battery, and clock; toggle usb0 mobile data cleanly without interrupting VoLTE or SMS.
  - Modem Debug & Factory Setup (Dbg tab): 7-point readiness checklist (USB ID, AT/SIM, IMS/VoLTE, ECM, Root ADB, UAC, Voice PCM), interactive AT command console with presets, and one-click provisioning for new QDC507-GL modules.
Zero Cellular 是专为 CardputerZero 打造的独立原生 4G LTE 蜂窝通信应用（适配 DJI(QDC507) 模组），基于原生 /dev/fb_lcd 帧缓冲与 evdev 键盘构建，使用FreeType 像素微调系统字体（DejaVu Sans + Noto Sans CJK SC Medium），全程以普通用户权限低内存运行。
主要功能：
  - VoLTE 高清语音通话：支持拨号盘、通话记录、来电振铃与提醒、通话计时、DTMF 按键、实时静音及扬声器音量/麦克风增益调节，内置 16-tap Blackman-sinc 重采样与 PipeWire 音频路由。
  - 短信收发：支持中英文长短信（GSM-7 / UCS-2）收发与自动重组、未读提醒、自动换行气泡对话与快捷回复。
  - 移动数据与状态监测：顶栏实时显示运营商、LTE 频段、RSRP 信号格数、电量与时间，支持在不中断 VoLTE 与短信的情况下开关 usb0 移动数据。
  - 模组调试与出厂配置（Dbg 页面）：内置 7 项就绪状态诊断、交互式 AT 指令控制台（含常用预设）以及面向未初始化的 DJI(QDC507-GL) 模组的一键/分步初始化工具
